Evan MeisbergerFilm & video

An athlete’s focus.
A storyteller’s eye.

I am a junior at Cedarville University studying Media Production with a film/video concentration. I love filming, editing, and bring ideas to life through the art of video. I am also part of Cedarville University’s live sports broadcast production team, helping produce high-quality livestreams for campus sporting events, including soccer, basketball, volleyball, baseball, and softball. Through class assignments and personal projects, I’ve been developing my skills in camera work, video editing, and sound design. As an NCAA track and field athlete, I’ve learned the importance of discipline, perseverance, and managing my time. I apply those same habits to my academics and projects. My goal is to be a storyteller for God's glory through video production. I want to create videos that point people toward Christ and make an eternal impact. I’m excited to keep learning, gain hands on experience, and connect with others in the industry.

Growing toward a career in film, video, and broadcasting. Interested in summer 2027 internship opportunities.

What I bring to a production

01 / Film & video

Filming & editing

My projects include the LMNT commercial, Cedarville Track & Field promos, and the OMNIMAX interview. Through these projects, I’ve gained experience in planning, filming, editing, voice-over, and sound.

02 / Broadcasting

Live sports production

I help produce Cedarville sports broadcasts by operating cameras, running instant replay, and serving as technical director using the camera switcher.

03 / Track & field

An athlete’s perspective

As a Cedarville track and field athlete, I bring firsthand experience with training and competition to the sports stories I film.
